Instructions.$Comment: All invalid-combat exits own the same cancellation cleanup.
Combat entry initializes exactly one selected cooldown while the aerial combat lifecycle is inactive.
Swoop readiness precedes every projectile scheduler in this shared aerial component.
Cancel a stale projectile lineup when command, target, flight, or controller ownership is lost.
Base and range/cadence lineups use the standard aim window.
Guidance and mastery lineups use the extended aim window.
Projectile aiming also yields immediately when swoop ownership is pending or active.
Mastery is the highest observable projectile profile.
Pattern with Guidance retains the guided aim window.
Pattern without Guidance retains the standard aim window.
Guidance plus Cadence uses the intermediate profile at cadence cooldown.
Guidance without Cadence uses the intermediate profile at base cooldown.
Cadence uses the intermediate profile.
Range uses the intermediate profile without changing cooldown.
DraconicProjectile is the base profile.
Mastery echo is the sole continuation allowed while a swoop is pending.
Pattern guided echo continues a protected two-phase volley.
Pattern standard echo continues a protected two-phase volley.
Highest-owned swoop roots are selected before the default profile.
Recovery commits the highest owned cooldown independently of the strike damage profile.
